text.description_html:
Hold Open Arm Parallel Mount Bracket

For use with Global Door Controls TC200, TC2201, TC400, TC500, TC600 and TC2200 door closers with Global HOA-1245-N Friction Hold Open Arms. Can be used with any surface mounted closer where the arm Shoe has a 1-3/4" Center to Center hole pattern.

Also available: Non Hold Open Arm Parallel Mount Bracket

Specifications: for Global HO-PAB-1245-N Parallel Arm Mount Bracket

  • Length: 4-3/4"
  • Width at Header Mount: 3-1/2"
  • Shoe Mount Holes: 1-3/4" Center to Center
  • 3/16" Thick Steel
